q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign‑in page, click **“Forgot password.”** We’ll email you a reset link that expires after 30 minutes. Let us know if you need further help.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs **$4 per month** (or an annual billing option that saves 20%).

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month, so for 5 people it’s $40 each month.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The Free plan allows you to keep up to 100 notes (and use the app on one device).

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please email support@example.com with your order number, and we’ll process the refund. Let us know if you need anything else.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Refunds are only available within 14 days of purchase, so after three weeks the period has passed. You can still contact support with your order number if you have any concerns. Email support@example.com for assistance.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no native Linux desktop app for Example Notes; Linux users can access the service through the web app.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: The web app requires an internet connection; only the mobile and desktop apps work offline.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to **Settings > Export**, select **PDF** as the format, and start the export. All of your notes will be packaged into a ZIP file that is emailed to you. Let us know if you need further help!

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click **Restore**. Let me know if you need any other help.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, SMS codes aren't supported for two‑factor authentication. You can enable 2FA using an authenticator app in Settings > Security. If you need further help, let us know.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The attachment size limit on the Free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No. After you cancel, you’ll keep all Plus features until the end of your current billing period. Afterwards, your account will revert to the Free plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted both at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply within one business day. If you need further help, you can email support@example.com.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes—annual billing saves 20 percent compared to month‑to‑month pricing.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan you can use Example Notes on up to 3 devices.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
